Unraid: Main → Flash (Boot Device) → Sys: Unraid: Main → Flash (Boot Device) → Syslinux Configuration. On the `append` line of the default entry add `lsm=landlock,` followed by exactly the list from before, e.g. `append initrd=/bzroot lsm=landlock,lockdown,capability,yama,apparmor`.
ffmpeg läuft auch so in einem eigenen Pr: Even so, ffmpeg runs in its own process with a seccomp filter and limits for memory and file size. Landlock additionally forbids any file access except to the book being converted – a second wall in case a crafted audio file exploits a hole in ffmpeg.
